name: Longbough Quiver
description: An elven-made quiver shaped from supple Longbough bark and lined with cured leaf-leather, fitted specifically to the length and balance of Longbough arrows. Worn at the hip or angled across the back depending on stance, with a soft draw-lip that prevents the fletching from snagging on a quick pull.
narrative_effects: Sized and weighted for Longbough arrows. Standard arrows fit but ride loose; the draw is faster and quieter with the matched ammunition.
The bark sheath holds its shape across years of use without cracking. Elven archers who carry one rarely replace it.
Minor Vaelmere export, like the bow and arrows it accompanies. Outside elven hands it is uncommon enough that other archers recognize it on sight.
